summary: Implemented Phases 1-2 of the keyed-S4-driver plan: modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed/modalTableauS4Keyed (bespoke keys-threaded fuel driver) and hintikka_congr_S4 (the crux, resolved unconditionally -- easier than the research survey feared) landed in LoopChecking.lean, lake-build-green, zero sorry, lean_verify axiom-clean, and committed. Phases 3 (termination/Hintikka top-loop), 4 (soundness), and 5 (completeness+decidability) are BLOCKED: in-depth source analysis established that every landed top-loop lemma these phases were modeled on (modalExpandBranchesHintikka, modalExpandBranchesGen_closed_unsatIn) is hard-wired to a single fixed rule-application function across its whole fuel induction, whereas the keyed S4 driver's rule genuinely changes every step as `keys` grows -- none of the generic machinery can be instantiated directly, and no S4 soundness lemma exists anywhere in the codebase to build on. A bespoke, keys-threaded analogue of each (est. 1500-2500 new lines) is required, well beyond this plan's original 10-16 hour estimate. No sorry/placeholder was inserted for the blocked phases; a full technical map with a 5-sub-phase decomposition (3a-3e) plus Phases 4-5 was written to the continuation handoff.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: Phases 1-2 complete and committed; Phases 3-5 blocked with root-cause analysis and a continuation handoff.

blockers.description: modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed_hintikka requires a bespoke keys-threaded analogue of CompletenessLoop.lean's ModalLoopInvHintikka/AuxStepPreserved/modalExpandBranchesHintikka machinery (fixed-apply, cannot be instantiated for a keys-varying rule) plus a re-derived measure-decrease engine (FmpMeasure.lean's combinatorial core is file-private, out of territory) and a confirmed-necessary S4-specific fuel value (modalFuel is provably insufficient at small formula complexity).

modalTableauS4Keyed_sound requires a new semantic lemma (no S4 minting-shape soundness lemma exists anywhere) plus a bespoke keys-threaded soundness top-loop induction (same fixed-apply obstacle as Phase 3).

next_action_hint: Re-plan Phases 3-5 as a dedicated follow-on (recommend --hard with H8 phase-sizing, per the continuation handoff's 3a-3e sub-phase decomposition) rather than continuing under this plan's original phase boundaries; Phases 1-2 are landed and should not be re-derived.
